lean.name: Nat.zero
lean.doc:
Zero, the smallest natural number.

Using `Nat.zero` explicitly should usually be avoided in favor of the literal `0`, which is the
[simp normal form](https://lean-lang.org/doc/reference/4.28.0/find/?domain=Verso.Genre.Manual.section&name=simp-normal-forms).
